newsitem.title: USA: Vermont Teddy Bear sees losses.
newsitem.headline: Vermont Teddy Bear sees losses.

text.p: The Vermont Teddy Bear Co. said Thursday it expected to post losses for third quarter ended March 31, and for the full the fiscal year.

The company intends to officially release its third quarter earnings in early May, but currently estimates that it will post a net loss 10 cents and 15 cents per share for third quarter on revenues of approximately $5.3 million, it said.
In the comparable quarter of the prior year, the company posted net income of $284,378, or 6 cents per share, on revenues of $5.1 million.

Shelburne, Vt.-based Vermont Teddy Bear said the third quarter traditionally has been the most profitable quarter for the company, and as a result of the projected loss, the company anticipates that it will also post a loss fiscal year.
At this time, the company does not have a firm estimate as to the size of the expected loss, given that there are three months remaining in the current fiscal year, the company said.
